required_edges.test: hero takes at least one goal-directed action rather than only receives events
opposition resists or changes the cost/constraint
hero's approach causes or deepens a meaningful cost
midpoint makes the climax decision necessary and different from the opening strategy
resolution is caused by the hero's choice plus established consequences, not an external rescue

anti_permutability_tests: swap midpoint and climax-choice: must break causality
remove price: must weaken/alter climax necessity
remove hero action: main conflict cannot still resolve identically
replace opposition with generic difficulty: adaptive resistance should disappear and gate should fail or downgrade
n16_limit: Independent blind false-PASS rate cannot be claimed from this single-model session; controlled fixtures may be built, but independent reviewer evidence remains open.
